overview.text: The Kelung (Square-headed) Cat Snake is a long, thin, mildly venomous tree snake of Taiwan, southern China, Laos and northern Vietnam.

identification.text: Long and thin with a large head (twice as wide as the neck), big eyes and cat-like pupils; usually amber or brownish.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Taiwan (up to 1,000 m), much of central and southern China, Laos and northern Vietnam.

behaviour.text: Active at night and mostly in trees. When threatened it coils and strikes like a viper, but its venom is mild.

diet.text: Small birds, lizards and sometimes bird eggs.

recognise.text: Big square head on a thin neck, cat-like eyes.
